The content manager class acts as a controller during the lesson. This class has 
three functions, (1) hold all the lesson information, including lessons and links to 
videos, (2) store any generated statistics such as question completion time as 
more maybe seen in Figure 39, (3) manage the flow of content and activities. All 
lesson activities content is defined in a List<FeedItemModel>, each item maybe 
either a type of question or video, as defined by an ItemType enum, which is 
used by the content manager to determine which activity to display the content. 
As the user goes through the lesson the content manager will iterate through 
this list each time nextItem is called.
